description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller responsible for handling WebAuthn registration and authentication endpoints, including initiating registration/authentication options, verifying responses, and generating tokens.

classes.name: WebAuthnController
classes.description: Controller for handling WebAuthn registration and authentication HTTP requests.

methods.name: registerOptions
methods.description: Initiates WebAuthn registration process by generating options for a new user registration.

methods.name: registerVerify
methods.description: Completes WebAuthn registration by verifying attestation response and storing the authenticator.

methods.name: authOptions
methods.description: Begins the WebAuthn authentication process by generating options for the user.

methods.name: authVerify
methods.description: Completes the WebAuthn authentication process by verifying assertion response and returning a token.
